headline: Karanvir Singh Gill steps down as non-executive director of Infomedia Press
summary: Infomedia Press Limited announced the cessation of Mr. Karanvir Singh Gill as a non-executive director, effective October 14, 2026. The company communicated the board change to the stock exchange through a routine regulatory filing. This is a standard governance update for the small-cap media firm. Routine management departures of non-executive directors typically have no direct financial impact on retail shareholders.
why_it_matters: Routine board exit with no impact on share price.
